question: At preregistered semantic cuts, do exact boundary tensors of natural hashed prime-field ECDLP Boolean networks have lower balanced flattening-rank growth than interior-rewired networks preserving the local predicates, graph statistics, interface and pins?

claims.text: Every admitted row has exact canonical-IR round-trip equality, exact total and prefix-count agreement, and independently replayed witnesses.
On the frozen held-out ladder, natural hashed networks have materially lower normalized exact boundary-flattening rank and lower rank-growth slope than paired interior-rewired matched nulls.
claims.if_supported: advance to a separately preregistered local-basis and composition-certificate experiment; no ECDLP or asymptotic speedup claim
claims.if_not_supported: do not advance this registered boundary-rank route on the tested cuts and sizes; no universal impossibility claim

claims.text: A finite rank census proves or disproves subexponential Boolean tensor contraction or prime-field ECDLP complexity.
claims.if_not_supported: only a proved family invariant and complete cost theorem can decide the asymptotic claim

hypotheses.statement: The repeated arithmetic and hash composition in a natural hashed ECDLP network constrains exact boundary messages to a lower-dimensional space than a close rewired null.
hypotheses.mechanism: Globally aligned repeated predicates create dependent rows and columns in balanced flattenings of exact boundary-count tensors; interior rewiring preserves local complexity while breaking that alignment.

null_population.why_n: One paired conditioned null for each of 16 instances in 12 draft cells; freeze requires test-specific preflight power and completion evidence.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed design: four arms over 192 source instances, one exact evaluation per deterministic IR, under identical frozen caps; then stop.
Run E0 and known-rank controls first; a miss invalidates affected cells but all attempted rows remain in the export.
Timeouts, OOMs, unmatched nulls and nonzero exits are outcomes and are not rerun; only recorded infrastructure failures may retry once.

invalidation_rules: any round-trip count, prefix-count, model-multiplicity or witness mismatch invalidates the affected cell
any nonzero A/A exact difference invalidates the affected cell rather than defining a noise band
a failed known-rank positive control invalidates that rank size
a modular-only rank is retained as a lower bound but cannot enter the primary verdict
a null outside the registered solution-count stratum is excluded from the conditioned panel and reported
a row produced under a different cut, cap, IR version, binary or analysis hash is excluded and reported
wall time is descriptive and cannot rescue a failed exact-metric gate

decision_rule.text: C2 advances only if correctness, A/A and positive controls pass; at least 90% of declared pairs have exact ranks; the Holm-corrected upper 95% interval for natural-minus-conditioned-null normalized log rank is <=-0.20 on the three largest b values for at least two m families; one passing family has natural upper rank-slope interval at least 0.10 below the null lower interval; and conditioned and unconditioned panels have the same effect sign. The route is not advanced only if controls pass, at least 90% are exact, every m family has corrected intervals contained in [-0.05,+0.05] on the three largest b values, and no slope separation. All other outcomes are inconclusive.
decision_rule.threshold: advance: D upper<=-0.20 plus slope separation>=0.10 and >=90% exact; not advance: D interval within [-0.05,+0.05], no slope separation and >=90% exact
decision_rule.statistic: paired cellwise median normalized-log-rank difference and Theil-Sen log2(rank)-on-b slopes
decision_rule.interval: paired bootstrap 95% intervals over source instances, Holm-adjusted over three m families
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: natural-minus-null normalized-log-rank difference and rank-growth-slope difference

inadmissible: taking affected data before this protocol is frozen and committed
using a graph-only serialization that omits predicate identity, parameters, port order, interface order or pins
selecting a cut after observing rank or support
substituting a smaller favorable cut when the frozen cut exceeds the cap
calling modular rank an exact integer rank
dropping timeout, OOM, unmatched-null, wrong-answer or failed-control rows
choosing the closest of failed null matches after 256 attempts
tuning rewrites, bases or orders on the held-out ladder
using wall time to override the exact rank decision
reading finite-size low rank as proof of subexponential contraction or an ECDLP speedup

literature.claim: The hashed-factor-base Boolean tensor network is the strongest overall mechanism lead, while solver-family performance remains an empirical question.
The current Network stores explicit graph/interface data but predicate behavior behind a trait object, motivating the typed predicate IR prerequisite.
